name: gpa-off-scale
description: Interface review R1 (2026-09-18): a cumulative GPA off Notre Dame's 4.00 scale is not a pass and not a deficiency — §2.2 cannot be checked at all. The form now refuses such a figure before it is stored; this is the floor under a record that already carries one, so the row can never read '35.00 meets the 3.0 minimum' with a green Met pill again. No other row in the same report may go on to quote the figure either: the §4.5 candidacy gate used to read “yours is 35.00” beside a §2.2 row saying the GPA could not be checked at all.

detailExcludes: cumulative GPA for admission to candidacy
